blocks.title: why your DM ads flopped, even with *300 conversations started*

blocks.caption: and Meta counted every single one.

blocks.text: in Ads Manager it's called "Messaging conversations started". it counts people who messaged you after your ad.
it doesn't tell you if anyone answered, if they fit, or if they booked. it only means the lead said hi.

chat.text: hey saw your ad, how does it work?

blocks.text: "lots of them just click on the ad without providing any data". the sorting is on you.

blocks.heading: you paid Meta for *300* hellos, and nobody had time to answer

blocks.text: it opened the chat. what happens next decides the sale: an answer, a fit question, a time to book.
Manychat keeps your ad trigger and sends the first message. the setter takes over when the lead replies.
it answers the chats your ad opens, in your voice, asks your fit questions one at a time, and books the ones who fit.

cta.line: and i'll show you how to set up your AI setter for free.
